sheets.title: The alliance with Alliance DAO
body: What Alliance DAO put in: 4,500 LUNA (prop A21 OTC), aDAO NFTs (the prior NFT partnership), 10,000 LUNA delegated to the Lion DAO validator, and 3 billion ROAR deployed — 1B staked in Lion DAO, 1B in the ampROAR-ROAR pool, 1B paired with LUNA in LUNA-ROAR (both halves compounding or staked in TLA).
What Lion DAO put in: 3 billion ROAR across the two deals, and 20 pixeLions staked by aDAO in the pixeLions DAO.

At work today: the 10,000 LUNA delegation has {validator.adao_unclaimed_luna|num} LUNA unclaimed ({validator.adao_unclaimed_usd|usd}); the commission Lion DAO earned on it, and the then-vs-now value of the NFTs and the ROAR each way, arrive with the alliance ledger (in build).
